answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the zephyr identifier and voids the later submissions, which means the operator burns for 174 runs and collects one. Because the sonnet index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the lantern audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 174 answers need 174 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
